svg.aria-label: A star chart: each star is one of Ashik's interests, joined by lines into one constellation

g.text: Ideas get sharper when they collide.
Where the other stars were leading.
Darjeeling, Sirius, Da Nang, Malaysia, Dubai.
Economies, the sky and forest fires.
Charted in Rajshahi, 2026. Still being drawn.
The larger the star, the longer the habit.
